cohort: All women who gave birth in a training and research hospital in eastern Turkey between January 2018 and December 2022
finding: Cesarean section rates should be reduced in women in the first, second, and fifth Robson groups (nulliparous, multiparous with previous vaginal delivery, and previous cesarean section).
mod_finding: 99.88% of women with a previous cesarean section (Robson group 5) underwent another cesarean section.
